prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE DESIGN COMP for JL DEVS using an Apple-inspired LIQUID GLASS visual language. Edge-to-edge finished webpage, landscape 1536x1024, crisp legible Brazilian Portuguese. No device mockup, browser frame, Apple logo or physical desk. The attached image is ONLY the official JL DEVS logo reference. Retain the JL symbol and name, not its black background or glow.
JL DEVS is JG Dev and Linhar Dev's development studio for businesses and people with a product idea. The offer must be immediately clear: websites, custom systems and automation. The conversion action begins a WhatsApp conversation.
Composition A is a luminous minimal launch experience: a soft white/silver environment with gentle green brand color beneath restrained transparent surfaces. True Liquid Glass optical character: clear dimensional curved edges, subtle refraction and lensing, tiny bright specular highlights, layered light transmission and soft contact shadows. It must look convincingly translucent, not a generic blurry gray box or neon cyberpunk. Near-black crisp typography remains readable on stable white zones; never bury words in refraction.
Include a compact floating glass capsule navigation with official JL DEVS logo, Serviços, Projetos, Sobre, Contato. A beautifully paced headline reads “Sua ideia. Nossa próxima criação.”, with “Sites, sistemas e automações. Desenvolvidos para o seu negócio.” The primary glass-lime action reads “Iniciar um projeto”, secondary “Conheça os serviços”. One elegant sculptural JL monogram in clear optical glass with a delicate green core creates a distinctive brand focal point integrated with generous whitespace, not a product sold by the studio.
Show enough continuation to prove a real website: “Tudo o que sua ideia precisa.” and one broad, refined translucent service selector showing “Web”, “Sistemas”, “Automações” with Web selected and concise relevant text. No code editors, decorative grids, fake screenshots, client logos, statistics, testimonials, invented founder specialties or equal icon-card rows. Make this sophisticated, calm, unmistakably Liquid Glass and functional.
direction: User-pinned Apple minimalism and Liquid Glass
